title: Time course before/during/washout per fly per box, simulated (3 repeats, base seed 11)

banc.analysis:
Control box: share of all neurons firing per step averaged 0.016 over 3 runs (from 0.016 to 0.016).
Dosed box: share of all neurons firing per step averaged 0.031 over 3 runs (from 0.031 to 0.031) — 92% more than control box. 3 of 3 runs were on the predicted side of the control box average; the gap (0.015) is 103.2× the run-to-run wobble (0.000).
Verdict for dosed box: SUPPORTED — the direction held in almost every run and the gap is bigger than the wobble.
